hotel_name: La Réserve Eden au Lac Zurich

claims.text: Philippe Starck redesigned the hotel for La Réserve.

findings.quote: Unique and elegant, the legendary hotel is reborn, after several months of an ambitious undertaking nurtured by the creativity of Philippe Starck and La Réserve’s vision of excellence.
everything has been redesigned to offer guests a refined and timeless experience

claims.text: The Eden au Lac has been a Zurich institution since 1909.

findings.quote: The Eden au Lac has been a Zürich institution since 1909

claims.text: The larger lake-facing rooms have balconies with views of the Alps.

findings.quote: Splash out on one of the larger lake-facing ones, where the light bounces in off the water, and from which, if you step onto the balcony, you can admire the rippling silhouette of the not-too-distant Alps.

claims.text: La Muña serves Japanese-Peruvian dishes for sharing.

findings.quote: guests can enjoy a relaxed and festive atmosphere while sharing the Japanese Peruvian specialties

claims.text: La Muña has a 360-degree view of the historic center, with the lake and the Alps in the distance.

findings.quote: La Muña offers a unique 360° view of the historic center, with the lake and the Alps in the distance.

claims.text: La Muña's indoor room occupies the former attic beneath the hotel's dome.

findings.quote: Inside, it has taken over the former attic beneath the hotel’s spectacular dome.

claims.text: Stained-glass windows by Ara Starck guide the light through the dome.

findings.quote: In the dovecote, stained-glass windows created by Ara Starck accompany and guide the light through the dome.

claims.text: Eden Kitchen and Bar is on the ground floor, with large bay windows opening onto the outside.

findings.quote: On the ground floor, with its large bay windows opening onto the outside, Eden Kitchen & Bar promises to be an essential meeting point in Zurich.

claims.text: Eden Kitchen's menu draws on Mediterranean-Italian culinary traditions.

findings.quote: A menu inspired by culinary traditions from Mediterranean-Italian cuisine

claims.text: Marco Ortolani is the Italian executive chef at Eden Kitchen.

findings.quote: As a young man, Marco Ortolani dreamed of discovering the world. Today, the Italian Executive Chef and his talented team bring its flavours to the Eden Kitchen

claims.text: DJs play at the Eden Bar in the evening.

findings.quote: In the evening, our “Three Angels for La Réserve Zurich” set the mood from the DJ booth.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes a small fumoir off to one side of the ground floor, behind an unmarked door.

findings.quote: The ground floor is almost entirely devoted to the bright main restaurant and bar. There is a DJ booth and a sneaky little fumoir off to one side behind an unmarked door.

claims.text: Philippe Starck says the design was inspired by an imaginary yacht club.

findings.quote: designer Philippe Starck claims to have been inspired by “an imaginary yacht club.”

claims.text: Skiffs and kayaks are mounted vertically inside the dome as a sculpture.

findings.quote: an extraordinary collection of skiffs and kayaks mounted vertically in the structure, forming a spectacular sculpture

claims.text: La Muña is on the sixth floor, reached by a glass elevator from the lobby, with a tree-lined roof terrace.

findings.quote: Perched on the sixth floor and accessible directly via the glass elevator in the lobby, La Muña overlooks the city from its tree-lined roof terrace.

claims.text: The Eden Bar menu is divided equally between cocktails and mocktails.

findings.quote: the menu is deliberately divided equally between cocktails and mocktails

claims.text: The Utoquai bathing area on Lake Zurich is just in front of the hotel.

findings.quote: sunbathing at one of the region’s typical badis (bathing areas), such as Utoquai. Located just in front of the La Réserve Eden au Lac Zurich

claims.text: The rooftop bar opens only in summer.

findings.quote: In summer, our rooftop opens with a fine selection of snacks
Our Rooftop Bar is now closed for the season. We look forward to welcoming you back next summer.

claims.text: Arrival by car is via Kreuzstrasse, where the hotel's main entrance is.

findings.quote: Arrival by car is via Kreuzstrasse, where the hotel’s main entrance is located.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited parking in the central location.
